limitations: Controlled local CPU, allocations and resource counts do not establish production page-load latency or an absolute optimization maximum.
Every candidate includes small and negative controls; rejected regressions remain in the scope reports. Repeated measurements and integration repairs count zero.
Authentication, session retirement, authorization, request bounds, privacy headers, mutable-input behavior and admitted-write ownership remain qualified under native entrypoint controls.

Frontend app inventories exclude shared framework assets and deferred chunks. Baseline build assets, source snapshots and earlier raw evidence were preserved. Only this task clone’s regenerable webpack cache was cleared for disk headroom and regenerated by the final full build.

Normal commit/pre-push hooks, hosted required checks, exact merged-tree deployment, authenticated production navigation and guarded original-workspace sync remain required after initial local qualification. Final receipts are separate to avoid self-referential commit identifiers.
